nodes.label: EXIF GPS Rational-to-Decimal Decoding
nodes.rationale: EXIF stores coordinates as degree/minute/second rationals plus hemisphere refs; zero-denominator rationals and malformed IFDs are rejected rather than crashing.

nodes.label: LAN Phone Mode (QR Code + PWA)
nodes.rationale: Tailscale recommended for remote access instead of port-forwarding to the open internet; iPhone Photos picker may re-encode and drop GPS before upload.

nodes.label: Lossless JPEG Segment-Filter Stripping
nodes.rationale: piexif.remove() only drops the Exif APP1; a custom segment filter also removes XMP, IPTC, and comment segments while copying compressed pixel data verbatim, keeping JFIF header and ICC profile which carry no identifying data.

nodes.label: Magic-Byte File Type Detection
nodes.rationale: Files are identified by magic bytes, never by extension — a .jpg that is actually a PNG is treated as a PNG.

nodes.label: Strip Verification by Re-Inspection
nodes.rationale: Every strip is verified by re-inspecting the output and listing the removed sections; warns if the image relied on the EXIF Orientation flag.

nodes.label: Synthetic Test Fixtures
nodes.rationale: No real photos committed; generator writes JPEGs with known EXIF (Eiffel Tower GPS fix, fake device/author/serial) for tests to assert against.

nodes.label: MetaStrip Web App (Local Server :8377)
nodes.rationale: Bound to 127.0.0.1 only by default so nothing leaves the machine.

nodes.label: defusedxml
nodes.rationale: Required by Pillow's getxmp() for safe XMP parsing.

nodes.label: piexif
nodes.rationale: Used only by the test fixture generator to write known EXIF.

nodes.label: pikepdf
nodes.rationale: Chosen over pypdf for more robust low-level metadata access and lossless saves; built on qpdf.

nodes.label: Pillow
nodes.rationale: Chosen over piexif for all metadata reading because piexif has been dormant since 2019; getexif()/ExifTags handles JPEG and TIFF uniformly and parses IPTC and XMP.

nodes.label: pillow-heif
nodes.rationale: Registers a HEIF/HEIC opener so HEIC flows through the same Pillow EXIF path.

nodes.label: BigInt Arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Binomial coefficients over large boards get astronomically large, exceeding float precision, so exact integer arithmetic is required.

nodes.label: Probability Calibration Check
nodes.rationale: 300 intermediate games: predicted 15.3% matched actual 15.3%; predicted 0% had 0 misses in 3,926 cells — evidence the posteriors are exact.

nodes.label: Independent Constraint Components
nodes.rationale: Constraints sharing cells are grouped so each component can be enumerated exactly via backtracking with per-constraint pruning, keeping enumeration tractable.

nodes.label: Exact Probability Engine
nodes.rationale: Enumerates every mine layout consistent with the revealed numbers rather than using heuristics, so each covered cell gets its true posterior mine probability (0 = provably safe, 100 = provably a mine).

nodes.label: Global Mine Count Weighting
nodes.rationale: A combination using j frontier mines leaves C(interior, M-j) ways to place remaining mines in unconstrained cells; weighting by these binomials yields exact posteriors for interior cells too.

nodes.label: Win Rate Benchmark (sim.js)
nodes.rationale: Benchmarked via node sim.js with corner opening, revealing provably-safe cells, else guessing lowest-probability cell: 95.6% beginner, 84.5% intermediate, 42.8% expert.

nodes.label: Deformed Shape Overlay
nodes.rationale: Dashed overlay of displaced geometry, auto-exaggerated to be visible

nodes.label: Direct Stiffness Method
nodes.rationale: Per member, local stiffness k = EA/L is rotated into global coordinates and assembled into global stiffness matrix K; constrained DOFs removed, reduced K·u = F solved

nodes.label: Mechanism Detection
nodes.rationale: Singular stiffness matrix from an unstable truss is caught and reported instead of exploding into NaNs

nodes.label: Pin-Jointed Axial Bar Model
nodes.rationale: 2D pin-jointed trusses only, linear elastic, small displacements; no beams, moment connections, distributed loads, or buckling check by design

nodes.label: Consistent Unit System (m, kN, GPa, mm2)
nodes.norm_label: consistent unit system (m, kn, gpa, mm2)
nodes.rationale: E [GPa] x A [mm2] = EA [kN], so forces fall out in kN and displacements in m with no conversion
